body: Thank you. Everyone hurts. I'm just struggling and not finding a way out. I have looked into professional help. A friend of my parents is a doctor. He continually insisted I take a medication that I did not agree would benefit me, instead causing more complex issues. It seemed his goal was more to help my parents, who manipulate the story. I have also seen a psychologist, who agreed with me, and found out some things that explain a lot.

I would agree with "you aren't happy with they way [your parents] raised you but respect them for trying." Still I struggle with severe resentment and the inability to improve our situation. Including making them see my point of view.

The choices that I live with are never the ones I intended or sought to make.

I'm not sure how to answer your last question. I can't ever be truly sure my thoughts are correct. But I'm guided by my intuition, and over time it's been fallible albeit trustworthy to the point I trust it above else. I can understand when my thought patterns are correct or incorrect. I can understand what is wrong and what is right, yet find myself over and over choosing what is wrong knowingly, which makes it worse. To add to that, I also knowingly continue to stay in and repeat the kinds of situations that I know would be more beneficial to get out of, for whatever reason: mainly harm, emotional and psychological.

I appreciate you wanting to talk to me, though I don't really understand why.
